analysis.reasonEn: Maintain wait-and-see for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI slightly rose from 24.3 to 24.6 but remains in oversold territory. MACD histogram worsened to -60141.6135, continuing weak convergence. ADX at 24.9 indicates early trend formation, but -DI is higher than +DI, favoring downward pressure. Trading volume at 0.75x the 5-day average, showing contraction. Price remains at 30% of the 52-week low of $468,000, indicating a continued downtrend.
